title: Fix AirPlay playback reliability (buffering/no audio after connecting)

requirements.text: Improve AirPlay runtime detection so the app correctly reflects when AirPlay is actually available vs unavailable, by using the `webkitplaybacktargetavailabilitychanged` event payload to set `isAvailable` true/false (not always true), and keep `isConnected` synchronized with `webkitCurrentPlaybackTargetIsWireless` on initial load and on change.

quotes: It connects to my patio speakers via airplay but when trying to play music, the app buffers a lot and doesn't play audio through the system

acceptanceCriteria: In Safari on an Apple device, the AirPlay button is disabled when AirPlay is not available and enabled when it is available.
When disconnecting from an AirPlay device, the UI reflects the disconnected state within 1 second without requiring a page reload.
No console errors are thrown from the AirPlay hook during connect/disconnect cycles.

requirements.text: When the AirPlay route changes (connect/disconnect), automatically recover playback by reloading the current audio source and resuming playback if the user was playing, while preserving the intended track and approximate playback position when possible.

quotes: when trying to play music, the app buffers a lot and doesn't play audio through the system

acceptanceCriteria: If a user is actively playing and then connects to an AirPlay device, the audio begins playing through the AirPlay device within 5 seconds without manual refresh.
If a user is actively playing and then disconnects from AirPlay, the audio resumes locally within 5 seconds without manual refresh.
Play/pause state in the UI remains consistent with actual playback state after route changes.

requirements.text: Reduce AirPlay buffering stalls by adjusting the player’s buffering/retry strategy specifically when AirPlay is connected (e.g., more conservative thresholding and/or quicker recovery actions on repeated `waiting`/low-buffer conditions), without regressing non-AirPlay playback.
acceptanceCriteria: With AirPlay connected, the player does not remain in a continuous buffering state for more than 10 seconds without attempting a recovery action (reload/resume) during normal network conditions.
With AirPlay not connected, playback behavior is unchanged (no new buffering regressions in the existing stream stability indicator behavior).

requirements.text: Add clear, English user-facing messaging in the player UI when AirPlay is connected but audio is not successfully playing (e.g., extended buffering or repeated playback failures), including a one-click action to retry/reconnect AirPlay playback (e.g., “Retry AirPlay” or “Reconnect”).

quotes: doesn't play audio through the system

acceptanceCriteria: When AirPlay is connected and the app detects prolonged buffering/retry failures, the UI displays an actionable message in English describing the issue.
Clicking the retry/reconnect action triggers a playback recovery attempt (and if appropriate, opens the AirPlay picker) without crashing the app.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI sources are read-only).
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Keep the backend architecture unchanged (single Motoko actor); do not introduce new backend services.
nonGoals: Implementing real-time streaming protocols or WebSocket-based playback control.
Changing media storage providers or introducing an external database.
